A synthetic project brief demonstrating context selection, not a real task or
an executed experiment. Status: proposed, no output or feedback exists yet.

## The one goal

and humidity by 2026-10-01. This is a project goal, not an evidence-backed prediction.

At a milestone, propose only durable observations with date, method, locator
and limitations. Freeze the approved artifact, obtain a bounded ingest approval,
then update sourced pages, reciprocal links, index and append-only log. Update
